namelist_definition.entry: Default: ' ' Full pathname of the land domain (fraction) file. Set from the xml variables LND_DOMAIN_PATH and LND_DOMAIN_FILE. KELM reads the grid dimensions, cell center coordinates, cell areas, mask and land fraction from this file, and hands them to the coupler as the land domain.

Default: ' ' Full pathname of the surface dataset. KELM reads the subgrid composition (PCT_NATVEG, PCT_NAT_PFT, PCT_URBAN, PCT_LAKE, PCT_GLACIER, PCT_WETLAND, PCT_CROP), the soil properties (PCT_SAND, PCT_CLAY, ORGANIC, SOIL_COLOR, FMAX) and the satellite-phenology streams (MONTHLY_LAI, MONTHLY_SAI, MONTHLY_HEIGHT_TOP, MONTHLY_HEIGHT_BOT) from this file.
Unlike ELM, KELM has no -clm_usr_name machinery to derive this from a naming convention, so it must be set explicitly -- normally in user_nl_kelm.

SNICAR snow optics lookup table (Mie parameters for ice grains). Both this and fsnowaging must be set for SNICAR to run; with either blank snow albedo stays at the cold-start 0.6 constant and grain aging is a no-op. Default: lnd/clm2/snicardata/snicar_optics_5bnd_mam_c160322.nc (ELM's default, under DIN_LOC_ROOT)
SNICAR snow grain aging lookup table (best-fit tau, kappa, drdsdt0). Default: lnd/clm2/snicardata/snicar_drdt_bst_fit_60_c070416.nc (ELM's default, under DIN_LOC_ROOT)

Full pathname of an kELM restart file (*.kelm.r.*.nc) to start a BRANCH run from -- ELM's nrevsn. Required when RUN_TYPE=branch; ignored otherwise. A CONTINUE_RUN takes its file from rpointer.lnd instead. Default: ' '

Full pathname of an ELM restart file to read as an initial condition.
READ-ONLY, and it reads an ELM file -- kELM's own restarts (Stage 6) are read by CONTINUE_RUN or kelm_nrevsn, not here. This exists to start kELM from ELM's exact state so the two can be stepped once from a bit-identical starting point, which is the only way to separate a coupling error from an arithmetic one -- the replay tests seed each kernel from ELM and so bypass the coupling by construction.
The soil grid is not taken from this file; it comes from the surface dataset and is identical by construction. Default: ' '

Default: .false. If .true., write kelm_stage2_rank*.dat from every rank, at init and again every step, for tools/compare_stage2_init.py to check a run against its ELM twin at the run's last date. It costs about 17 KB of text per cell per step, so leave it off except on small validation cases.

Default: 0 Detail level of the timers inside kELM's C++ (Pacer, on the driver's GPTL; they appear in the run's timing files with the "l:kELM::" prefix). 0 leaves them off; 1 times the launches and phases inside each step that the Fortran timers (canflux, hbuf, ...) cover; 2 adds finer pieces. Each active timer fences Kokkos, which serialises a GPU run, so leave this at 0 except when profiling.

Default: .false. If .true., round-trip a per-entity fingerprint through the Kokkos views at the end of the first step and check that every packed slot returns what was written to it. DESTRUCTIVE now that the kernels run: the probe restores the cold-start seed afterwards, which discards the first step's physics (and a finidat initial state). Turn it on only for a run whose results you intend to throw away. This validates the Fortran/Kokkos boundary plumbing: extents matching the views kELMCreate allocated, no setter silently rejected, both the int and double paths.
The map SEMANTICS -- bijection, landunit types, patch-to-column agreement -- are checked separately at init and are not controlled by this switch, because they need no Kokkos and cost nothing.

Default: .false. If .false., a boundary-check mismatch aborts the run. If .true., it is reported and the run continues.
Abort is the right default while the boundary is being brought up: a wrong index map is silent corruption and every kernel added later builds on it. Set .true. only when a long run must survive a known mismatch during kernel bring-up.

Default: .false. If .true., write the per-kernel diagnostic tables to lnd.log -- the "(kelm_kernels_report) rank ..." blocks (SurfaceRadiation, CanopyHydrology, CanopyTemperature and the surface fluxes, with min/max and NaN counts) and the SurfaceAlbedo report -- on step 1 and twice a model day after that. They were for bringing kernels up against ELM; leave them off otherwise.
All kELM kernels always run; there is no namelist switch for them. The library can still run a chosen subset (kelmKernelMod's kelm_kernels_parse) for kernel-by-kernel checks against ELM.

Default: .true. Run the ported SurfaceAlbedo at the end of each timestep, as ELM does. When .false. the albedos stay at ELM's cold-start constants (0.2 ground and canopy, 0.6 snow), which is correct for step one and increasingly wrong after that -- there is no solar-zenith dependence, no snow aging and no wetness effect. Requires fparamfile, since the two-stream reads the canopy optical parameters from it.

Default: .true. Run the ported Photosynthesis (Farquhar/Collatz with Ball-Berry) inside the CanopyFluxes Newton iteration, so stomatal resistance is computed at every iterate instead of read from a caller-supplied table.
Requires kelm_do_albedo, because the leaf-to-canopy vcmax scaling (vcmaxcintsun/sha) is SurfaceAlbedo's output, and requires fparamfile for the PFT parameters. Both are checked at initialization.
Supersedes kelm_stomata_closed: with photosynthesis on, the placeholder resistances are ignored.

Default: 284.7 Atmospheric CO2 concentration [ppmv], used to form the CO2 partial pressure the leaf model needs. ELM takes the same number from its own namelist under co2_type = 'constant'; 284.7 is what the I1850 twins use, so the default matches them.

Default: .false. Pin the per-iteration stomatal resistances CanopyFluxes reads at ELM's closed-stomata limit, rsmax0 = 2e4 s/m, instead of leaving them at zero.
A PLACEHOLDER for the unported Photosynthesis, and wrong in a known direction. Zero resistance is not "no stomatal model" -- it is stomata held wide open, so transpiration is unbounded from above. This setting puts the error at the other extreme, near-zero transpiration, so that the two runs bracket the truth instead of one of them silently looking plausible. Turn it on to grade the SoilWater profile without a confounding root sink; delete it when Photosynthesis lands.

Default: lnd/clm2/paramdata/clm_params_c180301.nc (ELM's default for this configuration, under DIN_LOC_ROOT) Full pathname of the PFT parameter file (ELM's clm_params). KELM reads only the fields a ported kernel needs -- roota_par/rootb_par for the root profile, smpso/smpsc for stomatal response, tc_stress for the cold cutoff on root water uptake, z0mr/displar/dleaf for the canopy aerodynamic chain, and xl/rhol/rhos/taul/taus for the two-stream canopy optics -- rather than the whole file, so that every field read has a consumer.
Required, since the kernels always run; init aborts without it. z0mr, displar and dleaf are not optional: unseeded they read zero, which drives ustar and rb to zero and NaNs every canopy flux, so they are checked at read time. Use the same file as the ELM twin, or the two models are not comparable.

Default: '' (just the C++-side default field list) Comma-separated list of ADDITIONAL history fields to activate, beyond the default set RegisterHistoryField marks default_active in History.cpp (TG, TV, H2OSNO, FSA, EFLX_LH_TOT, FSH, QOVER, QDRAI today). Not a full restatement of the field list -- an empty string means exactly the C++-side defaults, not "no history."
An unknown name, or a name already active by default, aborts at kelm_hist_init rather than being silently ignored.
